description:
A deep violet nebula split by a river of gold and cyan lightning. The cloud banks slowly roll and re-form, charges run along the stream and fine dust drifts through. Dark enough to sit behind your icons.

[h2]Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Cloud amount[/b]: how much the cloud banks move (0 = still).
[*][b]Cloud speed[/b]: how fast they move (0 = frozen).
[*][b]Lightning intensity[/b]: how bright the charges along the stream are (0 = off).
[*][b]Drifting dust[/b]: fine dust floating through the scene (0 = off).
[*][b]Fog amount[/b]: soft coloured fog in the dark gaps (0 = off).
[*][b]Render scale[/b]: lower it to save GPU on 4K screens or older cards.
[/list]
Every slider at 50 is the tuned look. Brightness, contrast and colour are in Wallpaper Engine's own colour options. The frame rate follows its FPS setting.
